A little visual magic, included

Every package includes up to 10 AI-generated images and up to 3 image revisions in total. Each revision applies to one image. I don't offer photo editing, though some adjustments can be explored with AI.

What counts as CMS?

One content collection and its template, like a blog, projects or team members. Individual entries are not static pages. Content entry and migration volume are confirmed in your quote.

What should you bring?

Your branding direction, copy and assets. Branding is not included. Hosting, platform subscriptions, paid tools and extra language versions are scoped separately.

Custom scope

More pages? A different mix?

Need more than 25 static pages, more than 8 CMS collections, or a different combination? Write to me for a custom quote. Projects with 2 to 7 static pages can also be quoted individually.

Request a custom quote →

Website maintenance

One quarter, the same price as your website.

Three months of maintenance cost the same as the agreed price of your website. If your build has a custom price, the quarterly price follows that amount.

What's included

  • Updates to supplied content
  • Image updates + monthly AI allowance
  • Adding supplied content to CMS

Content comes from you

I'm not a content writer. You supply the copy; I organize, format and improve how it's presented.
